# AFCMS - Shell Config

This project is a CLI tool written in TypeScript and based on the
[Deno](https://deno.com) runtime.

It aims at providing single native binaries created with `deno compile` to
quickly setup a terminal environment on Linux and Windows.

It includes the installation of ZSH, Oh-My-ZSH, Starship and some OMZ plugins
under Linux, and Windows terminal, PowerShell and Starship configuration under
Windows.
